title: Layered Audio ownership and evidence doctrine
summary: Layered Audio owns acoustic material meaning, immutable source/derived lineage, view-specific assessments, boundaries, scene-time projections and processing provenance. Execution providers own machinery, never acoustic truth.
invariants: Source evidence is never mutated merely to make processing convenient.
A derived signal is new material with lineage; it does not replace its source.
Assessment agreement is corroboration, not accuracy.
Transcript, speaker, pitch, music, spatial and alignment views may disagree and retain independent boundaries and surety.

provenance.claim: Current Layered Audio architecture and qualification baseline.
